title: Beyond Burden: A Health Capability Gap Metric as the Foundation for a GBD+ Framework
content: The Global Burden of Disease study quantifies health loss through disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) but captures only the outcome dimension of health capability. The paper argues that adding a structurally defined Health Resource Constraint component to DALYs would reveal a health capability deficit beyond what DALYs alone capture and distinguish realised outcome losses from the structural conditions that produce or precede them. The resulting Health Capability Gap constitutes a GBD+ metric: an extension of burden measurement into capability measurement. This reframing would align global health monitoring with the capability-based and rights-based commitments of the Sustainable Development Goals, Universal Health Coverage, and the WHO Constitution.
